newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Radio rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Radio rated buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it initiated coverage of American Radio Systems Corp as buy.
-- estimated a loss of $0.75 per share for 1997 and loss $0.33 in 1998, and estimated after-tax cash flow of $0.95 per share for 1997, and $1.46 for 1998.

-- says the fourth largest operator of radio stations in the U.S. is attractively valued relative to its peer group, set 12-month price target of $39 and two-year target of $50. Shares gained 1/8 to 36-1/8.
